skillsEval.doctor.title: Static diagnosis
skillsEval.doctor.hint: Reads SKILL.md from disk — no model call, no cost.
skillsEval.doctor.stats: {kb} KB · {body} chars of body · {assets} bundled files
skillsEval.rule.unreadable.hint: Missing file, no read permission, or larger than the safe read cap.
skillsEval.rule.missing-name.hint: Without a name the skill never enters the catalogue — the model cannot see it.
skillsEval.rule.missing-description.hint: The description is the ONLY thing the model reads before loading a skill.
skillsEval.rule.invalid-id.msg: Folder name `{id}` is not a valid id.
skillsEval.rule.invalid-id.hint: Use lowercase letters, digits and hyphens only (e.g. pdf-filler).
skillsEval.rule.name-id-mismatch.hint: Not broken, but confusing when you look for the skill on disk.
AWOG ignores this key — check it is not a typo.
skillsEval.rule.description-too-short.ms: Description is too short ({chars} chars, aim for at least {min}).
skillsEval.rule.description-too-short.hi: Say what the skill does AND when it should be used.
skillsEval.rule.description-too-long.msg: Description is too long ({chars} chars, keep it under {max}).
skillsEval.rule.description-too-long.hin: It sits in the catalogue of EVERY turn — long descriptions cost context.
skillsEval.rule.description-no-trigger.h: Add a “Use when…” clause so the model knows when to reach for it.
skillsEval.rule.shadowed-id.msg: Id `{id}` collides with a skill in the {otherSource} tier.
skillsEval.rule.shadowed-id.hint: Only one of the two is loaded — rename one of them.
skillsEval.rule.duplicate-name.msg: Name “{name}” is also used by skill `{otherId}`.
skillsEval.rule.duplicate-name.hint: Two skills with one name give the model no way to tell them apart.
skillsEval.rule.body-empty.hint: A skill that loads but instructs nothing is the same as no skill.
skillsEval.rule.body-thin.msg: Body is very thin ({chars} chars, aim for at least {min}).
skillsEval.rule.body-thin.hint: Write concrete steps, examples, and stop conditions.
skillsEval.rule.body-too-large.msg: SKILL.md is large ({kb} KB, threshold {maxKb} KB).
skillsEval.rule.body-too-large.hint: Move reference material into a bundled file and link to it.
skillsEval.rule.broken-link.hint: That file is not in the skill folder — the skill will fail mid-run.
skillsEval.rule.link-outside-folder.msg: Link points outside the skill folder: `{target}`.
skillsEval.rule.link-outside-folder.hint: It breaks as soon as the skill is copied to another machine.
skillsEval.rule.oversized-asset.hint: Consider keeping this file outside the skill folder.
skillsEval.eval.title: Activation eval
skillsEval.eval.desc: Ask the model whether, given the current skill catalogue, it would pick this skill for each sample prompt.
skillsEval.eval.budget: Per-run cap: at most {calls} model calls · ~{cost} · {minutes} min.
skillsEval.eval.needCases: Enter at least one sample prompt.
skillsEval.eval.stopped.error: Stopped: two model calls failed in a row.
